Olivia (CSM): Quick kickoff — Pelago Health onboarding preflight. Goal: 30-day onboarding with production readout. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, enablement sessions, and a lightweight feedback loop. Reply with owners and any blockers by EOD.
Maya (CS Ops): Added stakeholders list: Harry (PM), Liam (Eng), Raj (Infra), Emma (Security), Sarah (Data). Also tagging Sam for SDK + runbook. :wave:
Sam (Solutions Eng): I can own the SDK samples, live debugging, and the first enablement demo. Can do Tue 10am PT for a 45m session. Will prepare a repo with quickstart and a short smoke test: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'`
Liam (Eng Lead): Re: success criteria — do we have latency and throughput targets from the customer? They're sensitive to per-request latency for chat flows.
AJ (Product): Customer asked for: 1) 3 product flows integrated (triage chat, note summarization, search rerank), 2) <350ms p95 inference on their typical load, 3) monthly cost within the committed budget band. Also they want SSO + audit logs in place before pilot.
Olivia (CSM): Concrete success criteria proposal: 1) 3 flows integrated + smoke tests green, 2) p95 <350ms on dedicated dev env for 75% of test samples, 3) billing estimate reviewed and accepted by customer finance, 4) basic quality checks (BLEU/ROUGE style evals + 20 prompt checks) show no regressions. If anyone objects, flag now.
Raj (Infra): For private/VPC deployment we need AWS role + CIDR allowlist. Also need their SRE contact for firewall rules. @Olivia please collect the AWS account ID and expected egress ranges.
Emma (Security): We'll run an initial threat checklist: SSO, KMS, audit retention, and data-in-transit certs. I need their compliance lead to sign off on KMS setup — can the customer provide contact?
Sarah (Data): For evals I'll need 20 anonymized prompt examples and expected outputs. If they can't share real PII, synthetic samples are fine. I'll own the regression harness.
Maya (CS Ops): Proposed 4-week enablement cadence:
  - Week 0 (preflight): access, SSO, infra checklist, sample data handoff
  - Week 1: SDK + integration session (Sam) + quick smoke tests
  - Week 2: Performance tuning (batching/quantization advice) + canary plan (Liam)
  - Week 3: Quality checks + feedback capture (Sarah)
  - Week 4: Launch runway + handoff + renewal checkpoint (finance + PM)
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll drop a lightweight repo link by EOD and add a debugging checklist. Also plan a `live-debug` slot after Week1 demo.
Olivia (CSM): Renewal risk note: Customer's current vendor usage is low, finance flagged sensitivity to cost variance. If we don't hit integration OR usage within first 14 days, this becomes medium risk. Action: run a first-14-day adoption check (Maya) and set up a short usage nudges cadence (in-app/email) with PMs.
AJ (Product): We'll craft two quick adoption milestones to nudge: 1) test user cohort does 50 interactions/day, 2) product integrates 3 endpoints. If either misses at Day14, escalate to AM for playbook.
Liam (Eng Lead): Technical open items: canary routing, KV cache sizes, expected token distribution. Please drop sample traces (50 requests) so we can model p95. Also need to know if they prefer dedicated or hosted for pilot.
Olivia (CSM): Action items/owners (please confirm):
  - Customer contacts + AWS account ID — Olivia — due: tomorrow EOD
  - SDK quickstart repo + demo slot — Sam — due: Tue 10am PT
  - Infra allowlist + firewall plan — Raj — due: Wed
  - Security checklist + KMS contact — Emma — due: Wed
  - Prompt samples (20 anonymized) + expected outputs — Sarah — due: Fri
  - Preflight status note + risk flag (Day14) — Maya — due: ongoing
  - Finance estimate + acceptance — Harry (PM) + Customer finance — due: Day7
Olivia (CSM): One more: we'll do a 3-question NPS-style feedback at Week2 (post-integration) and capture two free-text pain points. Sarah will link that into the quality checks.
Maya (CS Ops): Confirmed. Posting a shared calendar invite for Tue 10am PT demo. I'll also add a small checklist doc in the onboarding folder and ping the customer for missing artifacts.
Harry (PM): I'll coordinate product-side milestones and join the Tue demo. For adoption nudges, I'll prepare templated CTAs we can send to their pilot users.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Quick note: sample smoke test command I'll include in repo:
```
# smoke test
export RW_KEY=... 
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this: ..."}]}' | jq .
```
Olivia (CSM): Thanks team — please react with :thumbsup: once you confirm your action items. If anyone sees a blocker (legal, compliance, infra) that prevents Week0 preflight, call it out now so we can re-plan.
Maya (CS Ops): :thumbsup:
Sam (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup:
Liam (Eng Lead): :thumbsup:
AJ (Product): :thumbsup:
Emma (Security): noted — will confirm KMS contact tomorrow.
Sarah (Data): :thumbsup:
